assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production small UI icon for Sylve, an original woodland fantasy card game.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D storybook fantasy inventory art. Match ornate overlapping card backs with thick aged golden-brass beveled edges, deep emerald enamel, warm walnut wood, and embossed golden botanical details. Tactile subtly worn surfaces, a fine dark contour, restrained dimensional shading, warm upper-left highlights and clear deep shadows. Premium painted game inventory art, not vector line art and not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: square canvas, exactly one centered compact symbol, filling about 88 percent of the canvas with all extremities visible and a small transparent margin. Strong broad silhouette and a few bold details that remain readable at 24 to 32 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, including holes and gaps in the symbol.
Constraints: render only the isolated finished icon. No scene, no surrounding interface, no ground plane, no background, no rectangular button, no lettering, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no additional objects, no floating particles, no outer glow cloud.
Primary request: one folded woodland map, a parchment map with three broad accordion folds, warm ivory panels and thick gold-trimmed dark walnut edges. A single unmistakable emerald green leaf-shaped location marker is embossed in its center; a short simple path is incised into the parchment. Three-quarter view, broad compact silhouette, simple folds. This is the navigation symbol for Le refuge, the forest village hub.
